rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Very steep narrow lane beside the rail line, with homes 2-5 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 2-5 m away along most of it

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 4 m away at 23 m and 5 m at the start; another block 16 m at 37 m. Rail cutting across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane, kerb to embankment and fence; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Lane serving the houses; rail noise from the adjacent tracks.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along it in the imagery; a van would stand out.

flags: Steep: about 16% at the best section, 22% max
Gate mapped 12 m away with a way round
sun_shade: Trees on the north side shade the lane; open to the sun from the west.

best_section.where: Kerb of the narrow Pike Avenue lane beside the rail embankment, between the two apartment blocks
